items.author: Joe Hudson
items.text:
A boundary is not “You’re not allowed to _____”

It sounds like “If X happens_____, I will _____.”

So it’s not: “Here’s how you need to change.”
It’s: “Here’s what I’m doing.”

items.author: Santa Carota Beef
items.text:
Wishing you a blessed and Happy Thanksgiving from our family to yours. 🧡

Heavenly Father, thank You for the food on our table and the people we get to share it with. As we gather for our first Thanksgiving without Mike, we miss having him in the kitchen and hearing his laugh over everyone talking. Thank You for all the meals he cooked and for every person he made feel welcome at our table.

Lord, be close to the families missing someone today. Give us the strength to say their names, tell the stories that still make us laugh and enjoy the people sitting beside us. May our time together bring a little healing to our hearts. 

As we head into the Christmas season, help us feel the spirit and magic of Christmas again, even as we miss the ones we wish were here.

Bless the hands that raised this food and the hands that prepared it. In Jesus’ name, amen.

items.author: Siddha Performance
items.text:
The World has taught humans

What they "should want."

As a result, they want prescriptive modalities,

Methods, techniques.

But a rare human

Sees that these things have not worked for him.

Thus, he wants the Real Thing.

No more games.

He wants . . . The Truth.

items.author: Pico Iyer
items.text: Essence of a classic writer, and perhaps of the wisdom of East Asia, too: “Love can make an ordinary evening poetic. Sadness, too, can do that,” writes Yiyun Li in her complex novel Kinder than Solitude.
